body: Extensibility planning follow-up complete: E1-E4 accepted as plan requirements, not runtime results. Revision 2 rv_01m4gc4bwr0ekm9n6vxc53g3kg saved durably; sha256:ad39882f3b59f556f0b369804718122a9168affe0ce83a8e29adf2a7acd43f6d. Saved readback exactly matches reviewed draft. Six new required tickets EX01-EX06 add public ability packs/SDK contracts, original custom foot/mounted animation support, enabled-module discovery/provider registry, authoring tools/templates/samples/docs, automatic controller/UI/save integration and independent author acceptance. Existing contract/executor/catalog/save/UI/QA/package tickets updated without dropping original scope. Total 50 work tickets plus final acceptance, 188 dependencies and 50 unique covering criteria. Independent reviewer /root/ability_extension_review accepted the exact proposal hash, found no blocking issues and verified graph acyclicity. Saved validation zero errors/warnings; storage zero pending/failed writes/conflicts. The common path requires no C# build or core edits; optional advanced effect providers use public SDK. Runtime custom-animation feasibility and actual ease of use are explicitly untested future EX02/EX06 gates. No execution run started; epic stays Backlog.
